definitions.explanation: something that connects two things or fills a gap between them
a temporary solution or substitute until the real thing is available
an ingredient that holds other ingredients together in cooking

examples.japanese: A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: To serve as a link between A and B.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雑談|ざつだん}→雑談：06639_zatsudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We made small talk to bridge the conversation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{先輩|せんぱい}→先輩：01451_senpai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{橋渡|はしわた}し→橋渡し：09606_hashiwatashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I serve as a generational link, bridging the gap between younger and senior members.

examples.japanese: つなぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for temporary work to tide me over.

examples.japanese: つなぎ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦アルバイト→アルバイト：01528_arubaito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To work part-time as a stopgap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧。
examples.english: Bridge funding until the budget is approved.

examples.japanese: ⟦ハンバーグ→ハンバーグ：01785_hanbaagu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Add egg as a binder for the hamburger patties.

examples.japanese: そば⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Wheat flour is used as a binder for soba noodles.

examples.japanese: つなぎなし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{十割|じゅうわり}→十割：25145_juuwari⟧そば。

notes:
DERIVED FROM:
つなぐ (to connect, to tie)

USAGE BY SENSE:

Sense 1 (connection):
- つなぎ{役|やく} (liaison, go-between)
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ (conversation filler)

Sense 2 (stopgap):
- つなぎ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (temporary job)
- つなぎ⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧ (bridge loan)
- つなぎ⟦{融資|ゆうし}→融資：04775_yuushi⟧ (bridge financing)

Sense 3 (binder in cooking):
- Common binders: ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (egg), ⟦{小麦粉|こむぎこ}→小麦粉：04922_komugiko⟧ (flour), ⟦パン{粉|こ}→パン粉：04926_panko⟧ (breadcrumbs)
- つなぎなし (without binder) - often seen with soba descriptions
